Name: Joja Sasquatch and More
Author: UsefulOrNot
Description:
Players can decorate their homes with a Joja version of Sasquatch/Big Foot/Dark Creature/asldkfjsquaskutanfsldk and statues from Leah's 8 heart event. These only appear after players have earned 8 hearts with Leah. There are no cutscenes, letters, or anything else in this mod. Just furniture. Furniture from this mod can be obtained from the Joja Catalogue.

Animated Egg Head Statues are available when using the Furniture Framework mod. Check video tab for examples.






If you would like to translate, please ask. AI translations are not allowed. AI was not used in the development of the mod. I do not give permission for this mod or any of my mods to be used with AI.
